title: C Suites
intro: The C Suites at Quantico is the best kept secret at MCB Quantico! Tucked away between the hills and tree you will find peace and sanctuary from the hustle and bustle of Quantico. This historic building offers an AirBnB style option while staying on base.

sections.heading: Location
sections.markdown:
The C Suites at Quantico is located on the main side of Marine Corp Base Quantico. It is just up the road from the great Potomac River! The base is just 35 miles South of our national's capitol, Washington D.C. while Fredericksburg is just South of us. The base does have an Amtrak and VRE station for easy and convivence!

**24/7 Reservations: (888) 409-STAY(7829)**

sections.heading: Suites
sections.markdown:
Our suites are more of a home styled apartment for you to stay in. Our suites are a 2 queen bedroom, 1 bath apartment that comes with a formal sunroom, formal living room, formal dining room, designated desk space with hard line ethernet, and fully equipped kitchen.

We are an AirBnB styled Recreational Lodging Facility. We are designed for independent travel. There's no front desk and no formal check-in or check-out — you'll receive your access details before arrival and can come and go at your convenience. Our team is available by phone if you need anything, but the experience is completely self-service for your privacy and ease. Each unit has an assigned parking spot right in front with additional guest parking spots. Housekeeping comes through daily Monday – Friday to provide clean linens, towels, take out trash, and do basic cleaning. There are 3 large TVs throughout the apartment- each one comes with cable and 2 are smart TVs for Netflix or Hulu. We also offer free on-site laundry, portable wifi pucks, privacy, and quietness, and on call staff.

Please note that our building is not wheelchair accessible and does require you to be able to walk upstairs. If this is a concern for you, please let me know and I can refer you to another lodging option. Our building is a smoke free building. We only have one (1) designated pet room. Please let me know if need this room and I can see if it is available.

The C Suites at Quantico is classified as a recreational lodging, therefore per diem do not apply to our facility. We do not charge any additional fees such as taxes or additional hotel fees. If you are staying with your pets, we will send you the additional required documents and payments. We do require a card on file, however for our longer-term guests we arrange a payment schedule that works best for you. This could be weekly, biweekly, or paying for a full month.

**Amenities:**

* Self-check-in with key code
* No front desk — enjoy total independence
* Hotel-quality comfort with Airbnb-style flexibility
* Contactless stay — easy arrival, easy departure
* Assigned Parking Space
* On site Laundry Facility
* Complimentary Wi Fi and Cable
* Fully equipped kitchen with: fridge, freezer, microwave, stove, pots & pans, coffee maker, plates, bowls, cups, and silverware.
* Bedrooms: queen beds, walk in closets, alarm clocks, portable fans, and a tv
* Sunroom: couch, chairs, and tv
* Formal Dining Room: table that can set up to 6
* Living room: couch, tables, chair, and tv

sections.heading: Cancellations
sections.markdown:
You can make changes or cancellations on your reservation up to 24 hours before your reservation at no penalty.

All changes to reservations must go through our 24/7 Reservation Hotline at 1-888-409-7829. Once the modification has changed, you will receive a new confirmation email.

Cancellations or changes to a reservation made any less than 24 hours prior to check in will result in the loss of one night stay ($139.00)

sections.heading: Payment
sections.markdown:
We accept all major credit cards.

At time of booking, payment must be made in full. Reservations are not considered confirmed until payment has been paid in full.

sections.heading: Eligibility
sections.markdown:
Anyone who has access to base is eligible to stay with us at the C Suites at Quantico. Reservations are accepted for all eligible personnel on a first come first serve basis. Reservations and room assignment are made without regards to rank, grade, or time of reservation.

Please know that since this is a historic building from the early 1900s, there are no elevators or ADA access to this building. Stairs are required to get into the building.

Reservation for MCB Quantico Recreation Lodging does not guarantee access to the base. Please make sure to verify all policies/restrictions prior to arrival. They may vary based on the installation and/or location. This may affect (but not limited to) certain guest eligibility such as DOD Civilians, contractors, retired civilians, sponsors, foreign nations, etc.

For more eligibility information, please visit the MCB Quantico Visitor's center page at [Base Access](https://www.quantico.marines.mil/Info/Base-Access/).

sections.heading: Policies
sections.markdown:
We do not offer early check ins or late check outs. Check in is at 4pm. Check out is at 11am. If you stay past the check-out time, you will be charged a late fee of one night ($139.00)

We do provide a full equipped kitchen, you must bring your own food items such as coffee, filters, condiments, and other food items.

Our housekeepers are only able conduct light cleaning around the apartment. Our housekeepers are not able to touch personal items, do dishes, or move personal items. If you would like your bed made, please make sure your personal items are off the bed. If you would like your floors vacuumed and cleaned, please make sure your personal items are off the floor.

Any unauthorized animals found inside the unit will be charged $350 and asked to leave without a refund for their stay.

Please not that during your stay, the building might not be available for safety and security reasons without notice. All individuals will have to leave the building immediately. In those events, the MCCS team will notify you and provide alternative lodging options and refund any funds from that point.

Mail is not able to be delivered to this building. There is a US Post Office located down the hill in the Town of Quantico to set up any mailing needs. There is also an Amazon pick up station located at the Marine Mart on Barnett Ave.

sections.heading: Pets
sections.markdown:
MCCS Recreational Lodging offers one (1) pet friendly room. To reserve this room, you may call the 24/7 Reservation number or book online and select the Pet Friendly Room.

No other rooms are allowed to have any animals in their rooms. If a nonauthorized animal is found in your room, a fee of $350 will be applied to your account and you will be asked to leave without a refund of your stay.

If staying in our pet friendly room, A non-refundable pet fee will be charged automatically to the guest's account upon check-in based upon the length of stay:

* 1 night: $30
* 2-6 nights: $65
* 7-30 nights: $125
* An additional charge of $50 for every 7 nights after initial 30 nights

sections.heading: Next Steps
sections.markdown:
Once you have booked your stay either through the 24/7 call center or through our online reservation system, you should receive an automatic email with your confirmation information.

You have until 24 hours before check-in to cancel or modify your reservation without penalties

3 days before your check-in date, you will receive an email with instructions about your remote check-in process and directions with how to get to our location.

At 3:30pm on day of your check-in, you will receive another email with your code, directions to our location, and our check-in process. Please note, checking in before 3:30pm is not possible at this location.
